name: Catching Wind

angles.text: As a shaman, you may feel torn between the Windshapers' reverence for elemental currents and the High Order's measured taking of elemental power.
As a mage, you may value the Index Esoteria's careful measurements and see elemental forces as a field of study.

faq.answer: The High Order sends an operative to study elemental energy at the Overlook Standing Stones in the Shen'dar Highlands. The operative carries an Index Esoteria to gather data from the windstones despite opposition from the Windshapers.
faq.q: What is the quest Catching Wind about?

faq.answer: The Index Esoteria is a High Order instrument made to extract, measure, and record elemental energy from the great windstone formations at the Overlook Standing Stones.
The Windshapers defend their sacred sites and traditional beliefs about elemental magic. They see the High Order's research and devices as desecration and fight to keep outsiders from the windstones.

The Al'Aketh are a violent group the High Order compares with the Windshapers. The High Order considers both groups dangerous zealots bound by inflexible beliefs, though it calls the Al'Aketh more violent.
The Overlook Standing Stones lie in the Shen'dar Highlands. Their great windstone formations channel strong elemental currents, making the site important to the High Order's research.
faq.q: Where are the Overlook Standing Stones located?

faq.answer: Fillion is a High Order operative or researcher sent to study elemental energy at the Overlook Standing Stones. After confrontation with the Windshapers, the High Order sent an adventurer with the Index Esoteria to secure the data.

aliases: why does high order want data
faq.answer: The High Order believes knowledge of the realm's elemental forces is vital to saving Zephras. It sees research as necessary to overcome threats that traditional beliefs cannot resolve.
faq.q: Why does the High Order need the windstone data?

sections.body: The High Order studies the wild elemental flows of the Shen'dar Highlands in hopes of saving Zephras. At the Overlook Standing Stones, its researchers use an Index Esoteria, a tool made to draw data from the great windstone formations. The Windshapers see these probes as profane trespass against the wind.
sections.title: Measuring the Gales

sections.body: The High Order's expedition and the Windshapers soon clash at the stones. The Windshapers call the study and taking of elemental energy a desecration of their sacred ways. The High Order sees them as narrow in their beliefs, much like the violent Al'Aketh. It will not let their resistance halt its work to save the realm.
sections.title: Clash of Dogma and Inquiry

sections.body: At the Overlook Standing Stones, the High Order meets hostile resistance, and the clash leaves blood among the windstones. The High Order secures its readings with the Index Esoteria. The Windshapers call the fighting a massacre, and the feud casts a shadow over Valanaar.
sections.title: The Standing Stone Massacre

summary: At the Overlook Standing Stones, the High Order seeks readings that may help save Zephras. Its expedition faces fierce opposition from the Windshapers in the Shen'dar Highlands.
